name: Bilastine
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Allergic rhinoconjunctivitis and urticaria (adults and adolescents 12 years and older)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 20 mg once daily, 1 hour before or 2 hours after food or fruit juice

key_interactions.drug_or_class: P-glycoprotein inhibitors (ketoconazole, erythromycin, cyclosporine, ritonavir, diltiazem)
key_interactions.effect: Bilastine AUC up 2-fold, peak up 2- to 3-fold (ketoconazole, erythromycin).
key_interactions.action: Avoid in moderate or severe kidney impairment.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Food, grapefruit and other fruit juices
key_interactions.action: Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after.

monitoring: QT risk factors in susceptible patients

pk.half_life_eskd: 18.4 hours in severe impairment (GFR <30) vs 9.3 hours normal; AUC 1,708.5 vs 737.4 ng·h/mL

sources.citation: Menarini International Operations Luxembourg S.A.. (2026). Drynol 20 mg tablets (bilastine) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA0865/018/001; text revised February 2026]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
